Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: IMAGE 1, the original front three-quarter full-body Social Brave King mecha illustration. IMAGE 2 is the selected rear view and IMAGE 3 the selected side view; use them ONLY to understand the two upright backpack tail fins. Produce ONE revised IMAGE 1, same square canvas, same full-body pose, camera, ivory background, framing, ink lines, cel shading and colors. This is a tiny additive correction, NOT a redesign or a new view.

ONLY CHANGE: add the TWO upright rear backpack fins visible in IMAGE 2, now seen from IMAGE 1's front three-quarter camera. These are the pair of narrow vertical aircraft tail surfaces with orange leading-edge/perimeter armor and graphite dark-gray central faces. They are rooted on the BACKPACK behind the two shoulder roots, inboard of the enormous existing horizontal bomber wings. Their bases remain behind the shoulder assembly; their upper portions peek above/behind the shoulder armor on the two sides of the head/mane. Keep them separate from the head, and respect front-to-back occlusion: face/crown, existing mane and shoulder armor in front, fins behind. Match their physical scale and taper to IMAGE 2 and their rearward placement to IMAGE 3, projected correctly into the existing front perspective. Both upright fins must be visibly readable, though the far fin is naturally more occluded. They rise to approximately the head/crown's upper height, not towering antennae. Do not attach them to the horizontal wing tips. Do not replace or rotate the horizontal main wings.

LOCK ALL OTHER DETAILS OF IMAGE 1: exact head/crown and long orange/ivory mane, cockpit-shaped chest and blunt orange nose, shoulder joint rings, broad horizontal wings and correctly oriented engines, thick torso, oversized heavy fists and finger armor, white/orange train shells on the outer forearms, hips, knee drill directions, front and rear calf tread runs, all side wheels, foot shapes and pose. Preserve their shapes, proportions, visible detail, lighting and positions. Do not redraw the whole robot from the reference rear/side, do not shrink fists or widen legs, do not add weapons or change palette. No text, labels, borders, diagrams or additional views. The result should look like the exact original front artwork with just two correctly placed rear fins added.
